dataset.citation: Candanedo, L. (2017). Appliances Energy Prediction. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: 10.24432/C5VC8G.
dataset.description: 19735条10分钟级真实建筑用电与气象观测。仅作为能源调度算法公开基准，不宣称为港口或AGV实绩。
dataset.label: UCI Appliances Energy Prediction

environment_contract.decision_scope: 在给定负荷、电价、碳强度和储能约束下选择充放电功率档位。
hard_constraints: terminal_soc >= initial_soc - 0.02 (hard admission and action-feasibility constraint)
unsupported grid export receives no revenue
test rows are unavailable before training completes
environment_contract.label: 港口能源与储能调度

reproducibility.python_hash_seed: not-set; algorithm RNG uses explicit random.Random seeds
